summary: TC-LAYOUT specifies the rendered browser command at 390x844 and 1440x1000 in light and dark themes. It checks the selected canvas and alternating square colors, 32rem square board, equal cells, overflow, visible focus, summary placement/width/gap, select/reset interaction, and counts all 64 square buttons. TC-BOARD preserves node --test selection, coordinate-validation, and Reset state checks; TC-SUMMARY checks the existing status text at initial, selected, and Reset states. The rendered browser checks passed at both viewports and themes, although this test-spec stage did not run them.

test_cases.oracle: Find accepted design anchors in docs/shiploop/architecture.md under Decisions / AD-2 — Board interface / Appearance and tokens, Summary composition, and Theme and observations. Run node scripts/check-board-browser.cjs --light-page '#f4f1e9' --dark-page '#17201f' --square-a '#e7dcc5' --square-b '#34746b' --board-max 32rem --focus-color '#214c46' --dark-focus-color '#f3c15b' --dark-class theme-dark --summary-below --summary-max 32rem --summary-gap 1rem. In light and explicit theme-dark at 390x844 and 1440x1000, observe the page and alternating square colors, 32rem square board, equal cells, no horizontal overflow, visible focus, summary below the board with a 32rem cap and 1rem gap, and all 64 square buttons.
test_cases.red: A saved rendered anchor is wrong, the board or cells are not square, overflow appears, the summary is misplaced or too wide, or one of the 64 square buttons is absent.
test_cases.green: The browser observations pass in both themes at both viewport sizes; the command output is recorded for each TC-LAYOUT viewport/theme result.

test_cases.oracle: Run node --test test/board-state.test.mjs for the existing selection, coordinate validation, and Reset state checks. TC-LAYOUT separately counts the 64 rendered square buttons; node state tests do not establish the rendered board.
test_cases.red: Selection state, coordinate validation, or Reset behavior regresses.
test_cases.green: The existing node:test state checks pass and TC-LAYOUT observes all 64 rendered controls.

test_cases.oracle: Run node --test test/board-state.test.mjs and assert the existing status is Choose a square initially, Selected: E4 after selecting E4, and Choose a square after Reset. TC-LAYOUT also checks visible status text after a browser selection and Reset.
test_cases.red: The existing status text or Reset behavior fails, or the rendered polite status does not report the selection and reset prompt.
test_cases.green: The node state assertions and the rendered polite-status interaction pass.
